# Harpy
Harpies are an avian human mutation, sprouting feathered wings and ruffled tails. They see the world through an ultraviolet view, and walk around on digitrade legs. Their most iconic ability, however, is to take to the skies!
## Unique Abilities
### Sing your heart out
- Harpies are capable of singing out a tune on the spot with their voice, allowing for you to play music wherever you are, as long as you aren't muffled.
### Take to the skies!
- Harpies can fly with their wings to [color=#1e90ff]increase their movement speed dramatically[/color], at the cost of [color=#FFA500]heavy stamina drain and a temporary inability to use their hands.[/color]
- Their wings give them better acceleration if there is no gravity on the station, but they still can't move without equipment when floating out in space.
## Diet
- Harpies have similar diets to that of humans.
## Benefits
- They [color=#1e90ff]run 10% faster[/color] than other species. - They slash with their claws, dealing [color=#ec3a3a]Piercing [/color]damage.
## Drawbacks
- Due to their digitrade legs, they are [color=#FFA500]unable to wear any type of footwear.[/color] - Harpies also breathe [color=#1e90ff]3 times faster[/color] than other races. - They are very lightweight, making it hard for them to pull any other species. - They take [color=#FFA500]15% more Blunt damage.[/color] - They have [color=#FFA500]weaker bones.[/color]
Harpies typically use the Firstname Lastname convention, like humans. Names can be relatively implausible so long as they are not direct references to other media. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Gustavo Baker - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Zoey Fisher - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Ellie Flapper - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Jim the Grim - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Chirp Falcon - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Birdperson - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Jet the Hawk
## Lore
While, upon a first glance, it would be presumed that the harpy species were a genetic offshoot of humanity it is actually the inverse. A now extinct birdlike species, in an attempt to preserve their species from an incoming disaster, used human techniques and genes to create the Harpy species. Though harpies share many of the physical capabilities as this extinct species, they have far more in common with human's culturally.
